name: hostrunner
description: Adds a status bar button to execute the host application with the provided argument.

hostrunner.buttonLabel.description: Overrides the default status bar button text. The play icon will always be kept.

hostrunner.scriptRunner.description: The executable to run the script with (e.g., 'bash', 'powershell'). Leave empty to run directly. Note: This can be overridden globally by setting the HOSTRUNNER_CMD environment variable on your Host OS.

hostrunner.scriptPath.description: The path to the script you want to execute. Can be an absolute path, or a relative path (e.g., './scripts/run.sh'). Relative paths will resolve against the host repository root defined by the HOSTRUNNER_WORKSPACE environment variable.

hostrunner.scriptArgs.description: Arguments to pass to the script.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
